data.name: Clash of Adventurers
data.detailed_description:
The free Steam Playtest is live now

Clash of Adventurers is an open-world indie MMORPG in development for PC, built with Unreal Engine 5. You can play it today: the free Steam Playtest is open to everyone.

Steam’s button says "Request Access" — but this is not a waitlist. Signup is open, and requesters are added automatically and instantly. Click it and you are in. No key, no application, no queue.

The world of Lumeria

Clash of Adventurers™ is developed by Devsland Soft, a studio incorporated to bring this project alive. The first Saga, ‘Arrival of the Adventurers’, is being built in Unreal Engine 5 for PC Windows.

Elemental forces attempt to take over the lands of Lumeria. You take part as an Adventurer to restore order and prevent the wild creatures from erasing the Human Race.

As an Adventurer you can explore the lands of Lumeria freely and forge your own destiny — the only boundaries are your skills and your ability to survive in the wild.

One class, one role

Collaboration and coordination are the core of Clash of Adventurers. Playing as an Attacker, Defender or Supporter, you will join other Adventurers to complete Quests, unlock Achievements, defeat the fantastic creatures unleashed in Lumeria — and perhaps engage in battle against other Adventurers who, much like yourself, are shaping their own fate.

What you can do today

  • Seamless open world — no instances, no loading walls between zones
  • Real-time combat — server-authoritative, with abilities, cooldowns and telegraphed enemy attacks
  • Parties — shared loot rules and stacking party synergy passives
  • Gathering and crafting — professions, recipes and world resource nodes
  • Player trading — direct player-to-player trades
  • Progression — level up and allocate points across six attributes

Current status

The full game has not launched yet and no release date has been announced. What is available today is the free Steam Playtest, patched every few days. When Clash of Adventurers does launch it is planned to be free to play, with no pay-to-win — paying will never grant power and never skip progression.

Wishlist to be notified when the full game releases, or use the Playtest button above to start playing right now.

One class fills one role: Attacker, Defender or Supporter. Party up, fight monsters, gather, craft and quest across a seamless world with no instances.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 6th-Gen
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:

  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 8th-Gen
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
